title: Alamar Biosciences 联合多所顶尖研究型大学推出全国性研究计划，推进神经退行性疾病血液生物标志物相关研究
author: Na
description: Alamar Biosciences announced a national research initiative in collaboration with top universities to analyze approximately 21,000 plasma samples from 10,000 Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) participants using its NULISAseq™ Neuro 220 detection kit. The resulting dataset will be made publicly available through the National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center to support AI-driven research and accelerate biomarker discovery for neurodegenerative diseases.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is leading a significant national research initiative with prestigious universities, expanding the application of its proprietary proteomics platform. This demonstrates market validation, strengthens its position in the neurodegenerative disease research space, and provides access to large-scale datasets that could enhance product development and clinical applications.

title: Alamar Biosciences 與多間頂尖研究大學合作啟動全國計劃，旨在推動神經退行性疾病相關的血漿生物標記研究
author: Na
description: Alamar Biosciences announced a national-scale proteomics initiative in collaboration with Washington University, University of Wisconsin, and Indiana University to analyze approximately 21,000 plasma samples from 10,000 Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) participants using its NULISAseq Neuro 220 multiplex panel. The resulting open-access dataset will be linked to the National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center and will support AI-driven biomarker discovery and validation for neurodegenerative diseases.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company secured a significant national-scale research partnership involving 10,000 participants and 21,000 samples, demonstrating strong market validation for its NULISA platform. The initiative positions Alamar as a leader in precision proteomics for neurodegenerative disease research and provides substantial visibility for its technology capabilities.

title: Alamar Biosciences Partners with Leading Research Universities to Launch National Initiative Advancing Blood-Based Biomarkers for Neurodegenerative Diseases
author: Na
description: Alamar Biosciences announced a partnership with leading research universities to launch a national-scale proteomics initiative profiling approximately 21,000 plasma samples from 10,000 Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias participants using its NULISAseq Neuro 220 panel. The resulting dataset will be publicly accessible and open to AI-driven discovery through a national data challenge, advancing biomarker discovery for neurodegenerative diseases.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company announced a significant national-scale partnership with leading research universities and major philanthropic organizations to advance its precision proteomics platform. The initiative demonstrates strong market validation, expands the application of its NULISAseq technology, and positions the company as a leader in blood-based biomarker discovery for neurodegenerative diseases. The creation of a large publicly accessible dataset also enhances the company's reputation and potential for future clinical applications.

title: Alamar Biosciences 的 NULISA 數據將於 AAIC 2026 上超過 140 場科學簡報會中亮相，突顯基於血液的阿茲海默症生物標記剖析之最新進展
author: Na
description: Alamar Biosciences announced that its NULISA platform will be featured in over 140 posters and presentations at the Alzheimer's Association International Conference (AAIC) in London. The company highlighted advances in blood-based biomarker profiling, particularly the eMTBR-Tau and BD-pTau217 tests, which can be measured simultaneously with 220+ CNS-related proteins in a single workflow. This represents a four-fold increase from the previous AAIC conference, demonstrating growing adoption of the technology in Alzheimer's research.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company demonstrated significant growth in adoption of its NULISA technology with a four-fold increase in presentations at a major scientific conference. The expansion of its biomarker detection capabilities and validation by leading research institutions (University of Pittsburgh) indicates strong market traction and scientific credibility in the Alzheimer's research space.

title: AAIC 2026 逾 140 份学术报告均采用 Alamar Biosciences NULISA 数据，彰显阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物分析领域的进展
author: Na
description: Alamar Biosciences announced that its NULISA platform will be featured in over 140 posters and presentations at the Alzheimer's Association International Conference (AAIC) 2026 in London. The company introduced its first multiplex blood immunoassay for eMTBR-Tau, a key Alzheimer's biomarker, which can be detected alongside over 220 disease-related proteins in a single workflow. The data demonstrates that combined detection of BD-pTau217 and eMTBR-Tau improves disease stratification compared to single biomarker testing.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company demonstrated significant scientific adoption of its NULISA platform with presentations increasing fourfold year-over-year (140+ vs previous ~35). The introduction of eMTBR-Tau multiplex assay represents a technological advancement enabling simultaneous detection of multiple Alzheimer's biomarkers, positioning the company as a leader in precision proteomics for early disease detection.
